svg.title: Figure 3. Elastoplastic torsion of a solid shaft (normalized)
svg.desc: Three normalized plots for an elastic–perfectly plastic solid shaft. (a) Shear stress over yield stress versus radius over c for twists of one, two and four times the yield twist: the stress rises linearly from the center and is capped at the yield stress in an outer plastic shell that grows inward. (b) Torque over the yield torque versus twist over the yield twist: linear up to one, then curving toward the horizontal asymptote 4/3; a hardening material keeps rising slowly; an unloading line from three times the yield twist has the elastic slope and reaches zero torque at a permanent twist of about 1.68. (c) Residual stress after unloading from three times the yield twist: the loaded stress minus the elastic unloading stress, positive inside, negative near the surface.
